title: Baseline example
text: For adults with condition A, treatment X is recommended as first-line therapy when there is no contraindication.

title: Modifier example
text: In adults with condition A and severe renal impairment, treatment X should be avoided and treatment Y should be considered instead.

title: Monitoring example
text: For adults with condition A receiving treatment X, renal function should be monitored and dosing may require adjustment.
